ex.t: The goods are transported by train.

title.ko: 라틴·그리스 어근: spect · port · dict · graph · chron · bio · ology
title.en: Latin and Greek roots: spect, port, dict, graph, chron, bio, -ology

explain.ko: 영어 어휘의 상당수는 라틴어와 그리스어 어근에서 왔습니다. spect(보다: inspect, spectator), port(나르다: transport, export), dict(말하다: predict, verdict), graph(쓰다: autobiography, photograph), chron(시간: chronological), bio(생명: biology), -ology(학문)처럼 어근과 접사를 알면 처음 보는 단어도 추측할 수 있습니다. 어근별로 묶어 익히면 어휘를 효율적으로 늘릴 수 있습니다.
explain.en: A great deal of English vocabulary comes from Latin and Greek roots. Spect (look: inspect, spectator), port (carry: transport, export), dict (say: predict, verdict), graph (write: autobiography, photograph), chron (time: chronological), bio (life: biology) and -ology (study) show how knowing roots and affixes lets you guess new words. Grouping words by root expands vocabulary efficiently.

notes.en: Read roots together with prefixes and suffixes.
Some roots look similar; check them.

notes.ko: 어근별 묶음 학습이 어휘 확장에 효과적입니다.
notes.en: Learning by root groups expands vocabulary.

examples.t: He inspected the building for a long time.
The goods are transported by train.

lines.t: What does the root of 'inspect' mean?

options: Pre- means before and dict means say.
Pre- means after and dict means write.
Pre- means with and dict means look.

lines.t: In the word transport, what does port mean?
So export has the same root?

trans.ko:
A: transport라는 단어에서 port는 무슨 뜻이야?
B: '나르다'라는 뜻이야.
A: 그럼 export도 같은 어근이야?
B: 응, '밖으로 나르다'라는 뜻이지.

lines.t: A large part of English vocabulary comes from Latin and Greek. Knowing roots, prefixes and suffixes lets you guess the meaning of unfamiliar words. For example, biology is made of bio (life) and -ology (study).

trans.ko: 영어 어휘의 많은 부분은 라틴어와 그리스어에서 왔습니다. 어근과 접두사, 접미사를 알면 처음 보는 단어도 뜻을 추측할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 biology는 bio(생명)와 -ology(학문)로 이루어져 있습니다.

lines.t: Today we will learn the root spect.
It means 'to look'. There are inspect and spectator.
Then perspective must be related too.

trans.ko:
교사: 오늘은 어근 spect를 배웁니다.
학생: 그 어근은 무슨 뜻인가요?
교사: '보다'라는 뜻이에요. inspect, spectator가 있죠.
학생: 그럼 perspective도 관련이 있겠네요.

items.passage:
1) He ___ the building.
2) The goods are ___ by train.
3) He ___ the storm.

trans.ko: 1) 그는 건물을 살폈어요. 2) 화물은 기차로 운반돼요. 3) 그는 폭풍을 예측했어요.

items.passage: She majored in (1) and is writing an (2). The book is arranged (3). She wrote while surveying her life.

trans.ko: 그녀는 생물학을 전공했고 자서전을 쓰고 있다. 책은 연대순으로 정리되어 있다. 그녀는 자신의 삶을 조망하며 글을 썼다.

items.passage:
VOCABULARY TIP
Learning words by roots
Rather than memorising words one by one, it is effective to group them by root. For example, knowing port lets you understand transport, export, import and portable together. Roots are the key to understanding advanced vocabulary.

trans.ko:
어휘 팁
어근으로 단어 배우기
단어를 하나씩 외우기보다 어근으로 묶어 익히면 효과적입니다. 예를 들어 port를 알면 transport, export, import, portable을 함께 이해할 수 있습니다. 어근은 초고급 어휘를 이해하는 열쇠입니다.

questions.q: Which words does port help with?

items.passage: The text says grouping words by root is more effective than memorising them one by one. The text says port is unrelated to transport. The text says roots are the key to advanced vocabulary.

trans.ko: 글은 단어를 하나씩 외우는 것보다 어근으로 묶어 익히는 편이 효과적이라고 본다. 글은 port가 transport와 무관하다고 본다. 글은 어근이 고급 어휘의 열쇠라고 본다.

questions.q: The text says grouping words by root is more effective than memorising them one by one.
The text says port is unrelated to transport.
The text was written by a lexicographer.

expressions.ko: spect는 '보다'를 뜻하며 inspect, spectator, perspective에 쓰입니다.

expressions.t: Port means 'to carry' and appears in transport, export and import.
expressions.ko: port는 '나르다'를 뜻하며 transport, export, import에 쓰입니다.

expressions.t: Dict means 'to say' and appears in predict, dictionary and verdict.
expressions.ko: dict는 '말하다'를 뜻하며 predict, dictionary, verdict에 쓰입니다.

expressions.t: Graph means 'to write' and appears in autobiography, photograph and paragraph.
expressions.ko: graph는 '쓰다'를 뜻하며 autobiography, photograph, paragraph에 쓰입니다.

expressions.t: Chron means 'time' and appears in chronology and synchronise.
Bio means 'life' and appears in biology and biography.
Knowing roots lets you guess the meaning of new words.
expressions.ko: 어근을 알면 새로운 단어의 뜻을 추측할 수 있습니다.

expressions.t: Learning prefixes, roots and suffixes together expands vocabulary greatly.
expressions.ko: 접두사와 어근, 접미사를 함께 익히면 어휘가 크게 늡니다.

prompt.ko: 어근 3개를 골라 그 어근이 들어간 단어를 한 문장씩 써 보세요. (3문장 + 요약 1문장)
prompt.en: Choose three roots and write one sentence each with a word containing that root (three sentences plus one summary).

task.model: The inspector inspected the building carefully. The company transported the goods to export its products. He predicted the storm. Knowing roots lets you guess the meaning of new words.

model_trans.ko: 그 검사관은 건물을 꼼꼼히 살폈어요. 회사는 제품을 수출하기 위해 화물을 운반했어요. 그는 폭풍을 예측했어요. 어근을 알면 새 단어의 뜻을 추측할 수 있어요.
model_trans.en: The inspector inspected the building carefully. The company transported the goods to export its products. He predicted the storm. Knowing roots lets you guess the meaning of new words.
